description: Ingestion boundary v1 core. Strict numeric parsing (A5/C4): values crossing the boundary parse strictly or quarantine — thousands separators, decimal commas, currency forms, scientific notation, booleans and non-finite numbers are named quarantine reasons, never coerced. The nz()-style fallback is legal only for fields explicitly declared optional and genuinely missing. Plausibility bounds on every quantity-bearing field; the deliveries bounds-guard returns the full A5 substitution plan (quarantined value, trailing-7-day-mean baseline from valid entries only, DATA_HEALTH task, UI banner naming the substitution). Normalization stage (C1/C2): unit spellings resolve against the injected tenant catalog — unresolved spellings raise data-health, never guesses; openPO waiting quantities convert to planning units at ingestion with MISSING/INVALID_CONVERSION_FACTOR refusals before the engine sees rows; money normalizes to tenant currency at ingestion (documentCurrency + tenantValue at the pinned usdToLocal rate; third currencies refused per Decision 7 local↔USD-only; unpinned days refuse RATE_NOT_PINNED; tenantCurrency is mandatory). Inbound hardening (H10): one gate for every artifact — dropzone, watched-folder and email-in all ride gateInboundFile, the source is recorded but never consulted. Content is identified by magic bytes (never by name), the declared extension must agree with the content class, the XML family is refused outright (XXE made structurally impossible), a ZIP must be an XLSX workbook whose central directory passes zip-bomb caps (entry count, inflated total, compression ratio above a floor, nested archives), formula injection is neutralized at the cell level with the OWASP apostrophe escape, and the injected AV hook fails closed in all three failure modes (infected, errored, malformed) plus no-scanner-while-required. Pure core: file IO, upserts, RLS and idempotency land with the M1 pipeline stages in the app layer.
